params.1273: Build an item of furniture in your house (such as a crude chair for the parlour).
params.1274: You will need two logs, 200 coins, a hammer, a saw and at least two nails. The hammer and saw can be bought from the Construction master.
params.1275: Bronze nails can be made from a single bronze bar with at least 4 Smithing. Bring extras in case some are wasted.
params.1276: Take the logs and coins to the sawmill east of Varrock, and have the logs cut into planks.
params.1277: Visit your house in Building Mode and right-click on the chair hotspot in your parlour.
params.1278: Choose to build a crude chair.
params.1279: If your skill is higher you may build in any hotspot you wish to complete this task.
params.2225: Building furniture is the primary way to improve your Construction skill and increase the rooms and furnishings you have access to.
